ingredients.name: Beetroot, peeled and cut into small cubes

steps: Simmer the soaked barley and brown lentils until nearly tender.
Add beet and ginger and cook until the broth becomes ruby and thick.
Season the stew and finish with olive oil while it remains hot.
items.guidance: Shishira Barley Beet Lentil Stew is composed for shishira with seasonal texture, produce, and seasoning Vata: serve warm and keep enough moisture in the grains. Pitta: moderate pungency and avoid hard browning. Kapha: favor the vegetable portion and use only the stated fat.
provenance: original lacto-vegetarian recipe developed for the R3 regional and practical cooking collection

items.name: Shishira Rice Yam Chana Pot

ingredients.name: Yam, peeled and cut into small cubes

steps: Bring the soaked chana dal close to tenderness, then stir the rice into its broth.
Add yam and cumin and simmer until the root pieces yield easily.
Season the pot and fold in ghee for a warming late-winter finish.

items.name: Shishira Quinoa Squash Mung Bowl

ingredients.name: Quinoa, rinsed until free of foam

steps: Cook the mung until partly soft before stirring in the quinoa.
Add squash and ginger and simmer until the grains open fully.
Season the winter bowl and finish with olive oil before serving.

items.name: Shishira Amaranth Carrot Toor

ingredients.name: Amaranth grain, rinsed in a fine sieve
Carrots, peeled and cut into small cubes

steps: Cook the pigeon pea until half tender before adding amaranth.
Add carrot and cumin and simmer as the tiny grains thicken.
Season, fold in ghee, and keep the late-winter meal moist.
